title: AgentOps provenance mine-event (E6, ADR-0010)
description: One deterministic per-inference provenance event mined from a session transcript by `ao provenance mine-session`. Only events the transcript deterministically evidences are emitted (today: tool_call); kind is extensible to context_entered / context_missed once their deterministic evidence is defined.

id.description: Stable, idempotent id: sha256(session_id:source_line:kind:tool:ordinal)[:16], where ordinal is the tool's position within its source-line message. A re-mine over identical input yields the identical id (trivial downstream dedup); the ordinal keeps several same-tool calls on one line uniquely identified.

tool.description: The tool identifier for a tool_call event (e.g. Read, Bash, exec_command).
